title: Catatumbo campaign
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Catatumbo campaign", at revision 1370610401, opens: "The Catatumbo campaign has been an ongoing period of strategic violence between militia faction groups in the Catatumbo region of Colombia and Venezuela since January 2018. It is an extension of the war on drugs and developed after the Colombian peace process of 2016. The existence of the war was officially announced in August 2019 after a Human Rights Watch (HRW) investigation." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q66474138, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "war between militia groups in Colombia's Catatumbo region over drug trade". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
